translations.web: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’
translations.bsb: So he thought to himself, ‘What shall I do, since I have nowhere to store my crops?’
translations.kjv: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
translations.asv: and he reasoned within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have not where to bestow my fruits?
